deploy.startCommand:
sh -c "python - <<'PY'
+import os, socket, time
+
+def wait_for(host, port, name, timeout=120):
+    start = time.time()
+    while time.time() - start < timeout:
+        try:
+            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=2):
+                print(f'{name} is reachable at {host}:{port}')
+                return
+        except OSError:
+            time.sleep(2)
+    raise RuntimeError(f'Timeout waiting for {name} at {host}:{port}')
+
+db_url = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL', '')
+if db_url.startswith('postgres') and '@' in db_url:
+    host_port = db_url.split('@', 1)[1].split('/', 1)[0]
+    host = host_port.split(':', 1)[0]
+    port = int(host_port.split(':', 1)[1]) if ':' in host_port else 5432
+    wait_for(host, port, 'postgres')
+
+redis_url = os.getenv('REDIS_URL', '')
+if redis_url.startswith('redis://'):
+    host_port = redis_url.replace('redis://', '').split('/', 1)[0]
+    host = host_port.split(':', 1)[0]
+    port = int(host_port.split(':', 1)[1]) if ':' in host_port else 6379
+    wait_for(host, port, 'redis')
+PY
+&& python -m flask db upgrade && python scripts/seed_data.py && python -m flask run --host=0.0.0.0 --port=${PORT:-5001}"
